en: Colorized historic view of a European riverside city with a metal bridge in the foreground, multi‑story townhouses along the embankment, and a steep hill rising behind them. On top of the hill stands a fortified complex with thick walls and buildings, and to the right a prominent clock tower on the hillside and another tall church or civic tower with a clock and baroque dome. The style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century postcard.
